## Screen spec (from Figma)
```json
{
 "screen": "LoginScreen",
 "figmaNode": "12:300",
 "root": {
  "type": "Column",
  "name": "Login Screen",
  "background": "color.background.primary",
  "padding": {
   "horizontal": "spacing.l",
   "vertical": "spacing.xl"
  },
  "gap": "spacing.m",
  "fill": "maxSize",
  "children": [
   {
    "type": "Text",
    "name": "Title",
    "text": "Welcome back",
    "style": "typography.heading/l",
    "color": "color.text.primary"
   },
   {
    "type": "Text",
    "name": "Subtitle",
    "text": "Log in to continue",

   {
    "type": "Spacer",

   },
   {

    "name": "EmailField",

     "label": "Email",
     "placeholder": "name@company.com",
     "isSecure": false
    },

   },

     "style": "Primary",

   }
  ]
 },

  "[Decoration 12:360] hand-drawn graphic; use a UIKit Icon/Image/component, or export it as an asset",
  "[PromoBanner 12:370] instance of 'Promo Banner' is not in the UIKit manifest"
 ]
}
```

## UIKit components used
```json
[
 {
  "figma": "Button",
  "description": "Primary action button. Use one Primary per screen.",
  "props": {
   "style": {
    "figmaProp": "Style",
    "values": [
     "Primary",
     "Secondary",
     "Text"
    ]
   },
   "size": {
    "figmaProp": "Size",
    "values": [
     "S",
     "M",
     "L"
    ]
   },
   "enabled": {
    "figmaProp": "State",
    "map": {
     "Default": true,
     "Disabled": false
    }
   },
   "text": {
    "figmaText": "Label"
   }
  },
  "swiftui": {
   "import": "CompanyUIKit",
   "signature": "UIKitButton(_ title: String, style: UIKitButtonStyle = .primary, size: UIKitButtonSize = .m, isEnabled: Bool = true, action: @escaping () -> Void)",
   "example": "UIKitButton(\"Continue\", style: .primary, size: .l, action: onContinue)"
  }
 },
 {
  "figma": "Link",
  "description": "Inline text link.",
  "props": {
   "text": {
    "figmaText": "Label"
   }
  },
  "swiftui": {
   "import": "CompanyUIKit",
   "signature": "UIKitLink(_ title: String, action: @escaping () -> Void)",
   "example": "UIKitLink(\"Forgot password?\", action: onForgotPassword)"
  }
 },
 {
  "figma": "TextField",
  "description": "Single-line input with label, optional placeholder and error text.",
  "props": {
   "label": {
    "figmaText": "Label"
   },
   "placeholder": {
    "figmaText": "Placeholder"
   },
   "isSecure": {
    "figmaProp": "Type",
    "map": {
     "Text": false,
     "Password": true
    }
   },
   "error": {
    "figmaText": "Error"
   }
  },
  "swiftui": {
   "import": "CompanyUIKit",
   "signature": "UIKitTextField(_ label: String, text: Binding<String>, placeholder: String? = nil, isSecure: Bool = false, error: String? = nil)",
   "example": "UIKitTextField(\"Email\", text: $state.email)"
  }
 }
]
```

## Layout primitives
- Column: `VStack(alignment: .leading|.center|.trailing, spacing: <gap token>) { ... }`
- Row: `HStack(alignment: .top|.center|.bottom, spacing: <gap token>) { ... }`
- Box: `ZStack { ... }`
- Spacer: `Spacer().frame(height: <size token>) inside VStack, Spacer().frame(width: <size token>) inside HStack, Spacer() for weight`
- Text: `UIKitText("...", style: <typography token>, color: <color token>)`
- padding: `.padding(.horizontal, <token>).padding(.vertical, <token>)`
- background: `.background(<color token>)`
- fill: `maxSize -> .frame(maxWidth: .infinity, maxHeight: .infinity), maxWidth -> .frame(maxWidth: .infinity)`
- imports: `SwiftUI, CompanyUIKit`

## Token table (spec token -> code)
```
color.background.primary -> Theme.colors.backgroundPrimary
color.text.primary -> Theme.colors.textPrimary
color.text.secondary -> Theme.colors.textSecondary
spacing.l -> Theme.spacing.l
spacing.m -> Theme.spacing.m
spacing.s -> Theme.spacing.s
spacing.xl -> Theme.spacing.xl
typography.body/m -> Theme.typography.bodyM
typography.heading/l -> Theme.typography.headingL
```

## Designer warnings (handle with TODO comments, don't guess)
- [Decoration 12:360] hand-drawn graphic; use a UIKit Icon/Image/component, or export it as an asset
- [PromoBanner 12:370] instance of 'Promo Banner' is not in the UIKit manifest

## Task
Generate the SwiftUI file for screen `LoginScreen`.
Required shape:
- `struct LoginScreenState` with exactly these properties: `var email: String = ""`, `var password: String = ""`
- `struct LoginScreen: View` with `@Binding var state: LoginScreenState` and one `let <event>: () -> Void` per event: onForgotPassword, onLogin
- Bind inputs with `$state.<binding>`.
- A `#Preview` at the end of the file.
